title: Godot GUI question (video showcasing my project for reference).
author: ResenhaDoBar
selftext:
I'm building a sports game using GPT 5.5 on Godot, but I'm having a hard time getting the GUI to look good, I'm using **godot-ui-designer** a skill I got here: [godot-mcp/.claude/skills/godot-skills/sub-skills/godot-ui-designer at main · hhhh124hhhh/godot-mcp · GitHub](https://github.com/hhhh124hhhh/godot-mcp/tree/main/.claude/skills/godot-skills/sub-skills/godot-ui-designer)

  
While I like the layout of the menu, the boxes feel very flat and boring. Agents usually build way cooler stuff in web applications using CSS, so I'm wondering, is this a Godot limitation or is the agent just not being able to do this right?

Would love some thoughts/recommendations
